name: Databricks SQL
model: Tables of typed columns, ANSI SQL, over Delta Lake or Iceberg tables governed by Unity Catalog; the Databricks lakehouse SQL warehouse
engine_note: Photon vectorised engine querying Parquet-based Delta/Iceberg tables in your cloud object storage; compute is SQL warehouses
consistency: Per table: ACID optimistic commits, WriteSerializable by default, Serializable as option; readers see a snapshot. Multi-statement multi-table transactions (BEGIN ... COMMIT) need Unity Catalog managed tables with catalog commits; still in preview.
scaling: Separated storage and compute: data in object storage, SQL warehouses sized and auto-scaled by cluster count; serverless warehouses start in seconds.
licence: Proprietary (Databricks service; Delta Lake and Spark underneath are Apache 2.0)

licence_events.event: Databricks agrees to acquire Tabular, the company of Apache Iceberg's original creators (Ryan Blue, Daniel Weeks, Jason Reid); closed 2024-06-07. Not a licence change.

managed: Databricks SQL warehouses on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
version_note: Current channel 2026.32; preview channel 2026.36 (release notes updated 2026-09-21).
reach: Reach for it when your data team already runs Spark or ML on Databricks and wants BI-grade SQL over the same lakehouse tables.
avoid: Avoid as an app's request-path database, or if you have small data and no Databricks estate; it bills per warehouse uptime (DBUs).
escape: SQL over the same open lakehouse tables your Spark and ML jobs use, without copying into a separate warehouse
chat: Analytics and training-data prep over message logs stored as Delta tables in object storage.
notes: Transaction docs (fetched 2026-10-04) say transactions writing Unity Catalog managed Iceberg tables are Private Preview and need DBR 18.0+ or SQL warehouses; the exact preview status for Delta-only transactions was not stated in the fetched summary, so I wrote 'still in preview'; verify before quoting GA. Tabular acquisition: Databricks blog says announced June 4, 2024, completed June 7, 2024; no price stated there. The press-release URL from memory returned 404.
